section.title: org.osgi.service.cdi.runtime.dto
section.para: CDI Integration Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: ActivationDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a component activation.
ComponentDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a component.
ComponentInstanceDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a component.
ConfigurationDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a component factory configuration dependency
ContainerDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a CDI container
ExtensionDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of an javax.enterprise.inject.spi.Extension dependency required by this CDI container.
ReferenceDTO - A snapshot of the runtime state of a component reference dependency

section.title: public class ActivationDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a component activation.

section.title: public List<String> errors
section.para: The list of errors which occurred during initialization. An empty list means there were no errors.
Must not be null.

section.title: public ServiceReferenceDTO service
section.para: The service this activation may have registered.
Must not be null if template.serviceClasses is not empty.

section.title: public ActivationTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template describing this activation.
Must not be null

section.title: public class ComponentDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a component.

section.title: public boolean enabled
section.para: Indicates if the component is enabled. The default is true.
A setting of false on the container component results in all components in the bundle being disabled.

section.title: public List<ComponentInstanceDTO> instances
section.para: The component instances created by this component.

listitem.para: When template is of type ComponentType.CONTAINER - there will be 1 ComponentInstanceDTO
When template is of type ComponentType.SINGLE - there will be 1 ComponentInstanceDTO
When template is of type ComponentType.FACTORY - there will be one ComponentInstanceDTO for every factory configuration object associated with the factory PID of the component.

section.para: Must not be null

section.title: public ComponentTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template of this component.
Must not be null

section.title: public class ComponentInstanceDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a component.

section.title: public List<ActivationDTO> activations
section.para: The activations of the component.
Must not be null.

section.title: public List<ConfigurationDTO> configurations
section.para: The configuration dependencies of this component.
Must not be null.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> properties
section.para: The resolved configuration properties for the component.
Contains the merger of all consumed configurations merged in the order of configurations.
All configuration dependencies are satisfied when not null.

section.title: public List<ReferenceDTO> references
section.para: The service dependencies of the component.
Can be empty when the component has no reference dependencies.
The component instance is satisfied when the sum of ReferenceDTO.minimumCardinality equals the size of ReferenceDTO.matches for each value.
Must not be null.

section.title: public class ConfigurationDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a component factory configuration dependency

section.title: public Map<String, Object> properties
section.para: The properties of this configuration.
The configuration dependency is satisfied when not null.

section.title: public ConfigurationTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template of this configuration dependency
Must never be null

section.title: public class ContainerDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a CDI container

section.title: public BundleDTO bundle
section.para: The bundle declaring the CDI container.
Must not be 0.

section.title: public long changeCount
section.para: The change count of the container at the time this DTO was created
Must not be 0.

section.title: public List<ComponentDTO> components
section.para: The components defined by this CDI container.
Must not be null. The list always contains at least one element representing the container component. See Container Component.

section.title: public List<String> errors
section.para: The list of errors reported during attempted initialization of the container instance.

section.title: public List<ExtensionDTO> extensions
section.para: The extension dependencies of this CDI container.
Must not be null.

section.title: public ContainerTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template of this Container DTO.
Must not be null.

section.title: public class ExtensionDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of an javax.enterprise.inject.spi.Extension dependency required by this CDI container.

section.title: public ServiceReferenceDTO service
section.para: The service reference of the extension.
The extension dependency is satisfied when not null.

section.title: public ExtensionTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template of this extension dependency.
Must not be null

section.title: public class ReferenceDTO extends DTO
section.para: A snapshot of the runtime state of a component reference dependency

section.title: public List<ServiceReferenceDTO> matches
section.para: The list of service references that match this reference.
Must not be null
Can be empty when there are no matching services.
This dependency is satisfied when minimumCardinality <= matches.size() <= MaximumCardinality.toInt() where the maximum cardinality can be obtained from the associated ReferenceTemplateDTO.

section.title: public int minimumCardinality
section.para: The runtime minimum cardinality of the dependency.

listitem.para: If template.maximumCardinality is ONE the value must be either 0 or 1.
If template.maximumCardinality is MANY the value must be from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE.

section.title: public String targetFilter
section.para: Indicates the runtime target filter used in addition to the template.serviceType to match services.

section.title: public ReferenceTemplateDTO template
section.para: The template of this reference.
Must not be null
